title: Insert a node at a specific position in a linked list
description:
[Source: GFG / HackerRank]
Given the pointer to the head node of a linked list and an integer to insert at a certain position, create a new node with the given integer as its data attribute then insert this node at the desired position and return the head node.

Input Format:
First line: n val pos
Second line: n space-separated node values

Output Format:
Space-separated values of modified linked list
